name: Question 6
problem: Consider the surface $\operatorname{ln}⁡(2{x}^{3}+yz)=3.$ Given that $n=⟨a,b,c⟩$ is a non-zero normal vector to the surface at the point $(e,{e}^{2},-e),$ what is the value of $\frac{a}{b}?$
worked_solution:
Let's define  $f(x,y,z)=\operatorname{ln}⁡(2{x}^{3}+yz).$ Then, our surface can be viewed as the level surface $f(x,y,z)=3.$  

Now, we find the gradient of $f(x,y,z)$ and evaluate it at $(e,{e}^{2},-e):$

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x,y,z) & ={f}_{x}(x,y,z)\,i+{f}_{y}(x,y,z)\,j+{f}_{z}(x,y,z)\,k \\  & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(2{x}^{3}+yz))i+\frac{∂}{∂y}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(2{x}^{3}+yz))j+\frac{∂}{∂z}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(2{x}^{3}+yz))k \\  & =(\frac{1}{2{x}^{3}+yz}\cdot 6{x}^{2})i+(\frac{1}{2{x}^{3}+yz}\cdot z)j+(\frac{1}{2{x}^{3}+yz}\cdot y)k \\  & =\frac{6{x}^{2}}{2{x}^{3}+yz}\text{ }i+\frac{z}{2{x}^{3}+yz}\text{ }j+\frac{y}{2{x}^{3}+yz}\text{ }k \\ ∇f(e,{e}^{2},-e) & =\frac{6{e}^{2}}{2{e}^{3}+{e}^{2}(-e)}\text{ }i+\frac{(-e)}{2{e}^{3}+{e}^{2}(-e)}\text{ }j+\frac{{e}^{2}}{2{e}^{3}+{e}^{2}(-e)}\text{ }k \\  & =\frac{6}{e}\text{ }i-\frac{1}{{e}^{2}}\text{ }j+\frac{1}{e}\text{ }k \\  & =⟨\frac{6}{e},\,-\frac{1}{{e}^{2}},\,\frac{1}{e}⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our normal vector is $n=⟨a,b,c⟩=⟨\frac{6}{e},\,-\frac{1}{{e}^{2}},\,\frac{1}{e}⟩.$

Finally, $\frac{a}{b}=\frac{(\frac{6}{e})}{(-\frac{1}{{e}^{2}})}=-6e.$

Question 6
?

Consider the surface ln⁡(2x3+yz)=3. Given that n=⟨a,b,c⟩ is a non-zero normal vector to the surface at the point (e,e2,−e), what is the value of ab?

a
3e2
b
−e
c
6e
d
−6e
e
1e
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Let's define f(x,y,z)=ln⁡(2x3+yz). Then, our surface can be viewed as the level surface f(x,y,z)=3.

Now, we find the gradient of f(x,y,z) and evaluate it at (e,e2,−e):

∇f(x,y,z)=fx(x,y,z)i+fy(x,y,z)j+fz(x,y,z)k=∂∂x(ln⁡(2x3+yz))i+∂∂y(ln⁡(2x3+yz))j+∂∂z(ln⁡(2x3+yz))k=(12x3+yz⋅6x2)i+(12x3+yz⋅z)j+(12x3+yz⋅y)k=6x22x3+yz i+z2x3+yz j+y2x3+yz k∇f(e,e2,−e)=6e22e3+e2(−e) i+(−e)2e3+e2(−e) j+e22e3+e2(−e) k=6e i−1e2 j+1e k=⟨6e,−1e2,1e⟩

Therefore, our normal vector is n=⟨a,b,c⟩=⟨6e,−1e2,1e⟩.

Finally, ab=(6e)(−1e2)=−6e.
